objectives: Memahami dan memakai relative clauses dalam kalimat dan teks berbahasa Inggris.
Menerapkan materi melalui contoh dan latihan singkat.
Memeriksa jawaban dan memperbaiki kesalahan umum.

blocks.text: Relative clause menambahkan informasi mengenai noun: orang, benda, tempat, atau waktu.
Who untuk orang; which/that untuk benda; where untuk tempat. Klausa non-defining biasanya diapit koma.
The scientist who led the team spoke first.
The device that measures rainfall is new.
My aunt, who lives in Bogor, is visiting.
blocks.note: Extra detail — Klausa koma memberi informasi tambahan.

blocks.incorrect: The place which I was born is small.
blocks.correct: The place where I was born is small.
blocks.explanation: Where mengungkap lokasi kejadian; alternatively: the place in which I was born.

blocks.text: Strategi latihan: baca seluruh kalimat, tandai petunjuk waktu atau hubungan makna, lalu pilih bentuk yang paling tepat. Setelah menjawab, jelaskan alasannya dengan kata-katamu sendiri.

practice.prompt: The author ___ wrote this article is a biologist.
Choose the sentence with a defining clause.
choices: The book that I borrowed is useful.
The book, that I borrowed, is useful.
The book where I borrowed is useful.
practice.explanation: That tanpa koma membatasi buku yang dimaksud.

practice.prompt: The city ___ she grew up is near the coast.
